platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: 1.5.3 adds an always-on adult-TLD ruleset (`.adult`, `.porn`, `.sex`, `.xxx`) at the published-list priority, so a name registered after the last list build is blocked instead of waiting for a list update. The document rule lands on the block page and every embedded type is dropped; the hand allowlist still wins. `decide` and the open-tab sweep model the same rail, and the static ruleset is pinned by the package check. `.cam` is deliberately not guarded. 1.5.3 also repairs the popup's status render (an undefined reference left the app row, lock strip, notices and details unpainted) and gives the embedded settings the popup's height: five fitting tabs, no pinned full-page footer or language row, a one-tap language switch, and a page area of about 461 px instead of 270. 1.5.2's private-window heartbeat answer, 1.5.1's removal of the browser-side private-window mode and 1.5.0's portable rules are retained.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION. 1.1.18 combines the 1.1.17 work on this branch with the MDM layer: the adult-TLD rail and the craft/extra-sites pass are retained, MDM enrollment is read as its own fact and the Organization policy layer names DEP/MDM versus a local profile, `profile/make_profile.py --mdm --team-id` adds a `com.apple.webcontent-filter` payload (plugin type, socket filter, designated requirement) and a `com.apple.system-extension-policy` that allows the Hisn filter and makes it non-removable on macOS 15+, blocks Erase All Content and Settings, and on macOS 26+ disables Safari private browsing. `HisnProfileVersion=2` and `HisnFilterManaged` let the app leave a profile-owned filter alone, `verify_mdm.sh --strict` checks the layers, and `--maximum` is the supervised-fleet preset. 1.1.16's aggregate blocked-connection count and 1.1.15's Organization Mode are retained. Unsigned/unnotarized.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team or test device; direct IPA path built, unsigned
platforms.notes: The app, six Safari blockers, HisnDNSProxy, HisnActivityMonitor, the scanner and two shield extensions share one version set. 1.8.0 adds the device-wide DNS filter: a Network Extension DNS proxy answers the signed core tier (236,586 domains), the four adult TLDs, 116 hostname terms and the person's saved sites with a local NXDOMAIN, and forwards only allowed names to Cloudflare Families over HTTPS. Domain and term data are generated from the signature-verified seed at build time and checked again by SHA-256 at start; a damaged domain list stops the extension instead of running unfiltered. The app gains on/off, readback, a route self-check through a reserved hisn.invalid alias and a commitment freeze. The old NEDNSSettingsManager Family DNS configuration is removed and the app entitlement moves from dns-settings to dns-proxy. 1.8.0 also adds the direct distribution path: ios/direct/build_direct.sh packages an IPA outside the App Store and make_source.py writes the AltStore source from its bytes. Simulator-tested only; the DNS extension, the permission prompt and the direct install need a signed device. 1.7.2's adult-TLD Safari rules, 1.7.1's weekday quiet hours and 1.7.0's pause rule are retained.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: development · 1.5.1 source, core/build/lint, protected-window cover, live adult/people visual suites, signed Play/direct builds; no 1.5.1 phone adult test
platforms.notes: 39 (1.5.1) makes protected and private windows explicit instead of a silent visual failure. Android returns ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_SECURE_WINDOW (6) for Chrome Incognito and every FLAG_SECURE window; no accessibility or MediaProjection screenshot can return those pixels without root or a system privilege, and HaramBlur cannot bypass that either. Hisn now reports a PROTECTED state and covers the whole selected window with the same touch-blocking accessibility overlay, using the copy 'Hisn can't check this window / This private or protected window blocks screenshots. Close it or switch apps.' It retries at 2 s without discarding the loaded runtime; the overlay clears on leaving, screen off or disabling the layer. Text and DNS layers remain independent and active in incognito where the app exposes them. The 1.5.0 people cover, native adult TFLite path, moving-screen 350 ms cadence, verdict cache and after-block pause are retained. On the API 36 emulator the FLAG_SECURE fixture reported STATE PROTECTED, CAPTURE_ERROR 6, OVERLAYS 1, 0 samples from the protected window; the people-off live suite still passes. No adult-positive corpus, phone adult test, battery or thermal measurement is claimed. Signed Play APK/AAB and direct APK pass check-release.py and apksigner; no Play upload.
